steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test tenant.
Set the condition under test so vendors cannot be added during event creation.
Apply the additional configuration specified by the case.
Configure the draft as an RFQ-only eRFX project.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the draft is valid enough to save.
Add the required project line item.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a schedule for the saved draft.
Create the saved eRFX draft that will be inspected.
Confirm the draft save did not produce an application error.
Navigate to the Events list to verify and reopen the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered before filtering.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Verify that the draft created by this plan appears in Drafts.
Confirm the created event has Draft status.
Reopen this plan's saved draft for the control-availability check.
Assert that Terms & Conditions is not offered on the saved draft under the Off setting.
